## Faust : Exporting {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- Faust manages to **export** an audio program to many different platforms thanks to its ***architecture file system***.
:::
- Every single **export target** is materialized by a **specific architecture file**, **written in C++**.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="1-5|7-11|13-14|16-18|19-21|23-26|28-30|32-33|35-38" filename="faust/architecture/pa-gtk.cpp"}
// Include code from the faust C++ libraries:
#include "faust/gui/FUI.h"
#include "faust/misc.h"
#include "faust/audio/portaudio-dsp.h"
#include "faust/gui/GTKUI.h"

// These are markers used to indicate to the Faust compiler
// where to 'paste' the generated DSP code
// from the .dsp file
<<includeIntrinsic>>
<<includeclass>>

// Create a DSP object
mydsp DSP;

// Program entrypoint:
int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
  // Build the GTK User Interface:
  GUI* interface = new GTKUI (appname, &argc, &argv);
  DSP.buildUserInterface(interface);

  // Get the sample-rate from command-line arguments:
  long srate = (long)lopt(argv, "--sample-rate", 44100);
  // Get the buffer size from command-line arguments:
  int fpb = lopt(argv, "--buffer", 128);

  // Create the portaudio backend and initialize it:
  portaudio audio(srate, fpb);
  audio.init(appname, &DSP);

  // Run the interface:
  interface->run();

  // When the GTK Interface is closed, stop the audio
  // and deallocate the interface.  
  audio.stop();
  delete interface;o
}
```

## Faust : Exporting {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- Faust manages to **export** an audio program to many different platforms thanks to its ***architecture file system***.
- Every single **export target** is materialized by a **specific architecture file**, **written in C++**.
:::
- The architecture file is **completely generic**, it doesn't change depending on the Faust program.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="|" filename="faust/architecture/pa-gtk.cpp"}
// Include code from the faust C++ libraries:
#include "faust/gui/FUI.h"
#include "faust/misc.h"
#include "faust/audio/portaudio-dsp.h"
#include "faust/gui/GTKUI.h"

// These are markers used to indicate to the Faust compiler
// where to 'paste' the generated DSP code
// from the .dsp file
<<includeIntrinsic>>
<<includeclass>>

// Create a DSP object
mydsp DSP;

// Program entrypoint:
int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
  // Build the GTK User Interface:
  GUI* interface = new GTKUI (appname, &argc, &argv);
  DSP.buildUserInterface(interface);

  // Get the sample-rate from command-line arguments:
  long srate = (long)lopt(argv, "--sample-rate", 44100);
  // Get the buffer size from command-line arguments:
  int fpb = lopt(argv, "--buffer", 128);

  // Create the portaudio backend and initialize it:
  portaudio audio(srate, fpb);
  audio.init(appname, &DSP);

  // Run the interface:
  interface->run();

  // When the GTK Interface is closed, stop the audio
  // and deallocate the interface.  
  audio.stop();
  delete interface;
}
```

## Faust : Exporting {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- Faust manages to **export** an audio program to many different platforms thanks to its ***architecture file system***.
- Every single **export target** is materialized by a **specific architecture file**, **written in C++**.
- The architecture file is **completely generic**, it doesn't change depending on the Faust program.
:::
- Instead, the **generated C++ code** for the **DSP program** is going to be inserted inside the architecture file, to create the **final compilable file**.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="1-5|7-10|12|14-20|23|25-30|32-60|62-64|66-69|71-82|" filename="fm.cpp"}
/* ------------------------------------------------------------
name: "fm"
Code generated with Faust 2.88.0 (https://faust.grame.fr)
Compilation options: -lang cpp -fpga-mem-th 4 -ct 1 -es 1 -mcd 16 -mdd 1024 -mdy 33 -single -ftz 0
------------------------------------------------------------ */

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <math.h>

class mydsp : public dsp {
private:
  int fSampleRate;
  float fConst0;
  float fConst1;
  float fRec2[2];
  float fConst2;
  float fRec1[2];
  float fRec0[2];
	
public:
  mydsp() {}

  virtual int getNumInputs() {
 	return 0;
  }
  virtual int getNumOutputs() {
 	return 1;
  }

  virtual void instanceConstants(int sample_rate) {
 	fSampleRate = sample_rate;
 	fConst0 = std::min<float>(1.92e+05f, std::max<float>(1.0f, static_cast<float>(fSampleRate)));
 	fConst1 = 4.4e+02f / fConst0;
 	fConst2 = 1.0f / fConst0;
  }

  virtual void instanceClear() {
 	for (int l0 = 0; l0 < 2; l0 = faust_wrap_add(l0, 1)) {
  		fRec2[l0] = 0.0f;
 	}
 	for (int l1 = 0; l1 < 2; l1 = faust_wrap_add(l1, 1)) {
  		fRec1[l1] = 0.0f;
 	}
 	for (int l2 = 0; l2 < 2; l2 = faust_wrap_add(l2, 1)) {
  		fRec0[l2] = 0.0f;
 	}
  }

  virtual void init(int sample_rate) {
 	classInit(sample_rate);
 	instanceInit(sample_rate);
  }

  virtual void instanceInit(int sample_rate) {
 	instanceConstants(sample_rate);
 	instanceResetUserInterface();
 	instanceClear();
  }

  virtual int getSampleRate() {
 	return fSampleRate;
  }

  virtual void buildUserInterface(UI* ui_interface) {
 	ui_interface->openVerticalBox("fm");
 	ui_interface->closeBox();
  }

  virtual void compute(int count, FAUSTFLOAT** RESTRICT inputs, FAUSTFLOAT** RESTRICT outputs) {
 	FAUSTFLOAT* output0 = outputs[0];
 	for (int i0 = 0; i0 < count; i0 = faust_wrap_add(i0, 1)) {
  		fRec2[0] = fConst1 - std::floor(fRec2[1]) + fRec2[1];
  		float fTemp0 = 4.4e+02f + 1.32e+03f * std::cos(6.2831855f * fRec2[1]);
  		fRec1[0] = fRec1[1] + fConst2 * fTemp0 - std::floor(fRec1[1]);
  		fRec0[0] = fRec0[1] + fConst2 * (4.4e+02f + 2.0f * fTemp0 * std::cos(6.2831855f * fRec1[1])) - std::floor(fRec0[1]);
  		output0[i0] = static_cast<FAUSTFLOAT>(std::cos(6.2831855f * fRec0[1]));
  		fRec2[1] = fRec2[0];
  		fRec1[1] = fRec1[0];
  		fRec0[1] = fRec0[0];
 	}
  }
};
```
